recipes.name: Black Forest Overnight Oats
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the oats, milk, flaxseeds, almond butter, cocoa, and almond extract.
Spoon the mixture into a mason jar, alternating with spoonfuls of the cherry pie filling. Cover and place in the fridge overnight.
In the morning, top with yogurt and other desired toppings and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Nutrition tip: aim to use plant-based milk and yogurt that are fortified with calcium .
Storage Store in the fridge in an airtight container for up to 3 days.
